policy: A user-accepted capability is protected. New work must not change its accepted behavior unless that capability is the explicit change target and the full regression suite passes again.

stable_reference.note: v140 is not a stable baseline because receipt mailing regressed while meter work advanced. Recovery must compose accepted implementations rather than treating v140 wholesale as stable.

modules.contract: Main dashboard opens and launches accepted modules without changing their behavior.
Login/session and manual receipt synchronization continue to work with existing archive identity logic.
Background receipt checking completes independently and reports a fresh result without damaging archive or state.
Downloaded PDFs are normalized/sorted without deleting unrelated receipts or local history.

modules.accepted_reference: v106 plus later accepted AccountStatus fixes
modules.contract: 1-2 successful misses => missing; 3 => inactive; return => active; explicit exclusion/restoration persists.
Existing connection/proxy settings remain compatible with accepted portal operations.
The exact user-accepted receipt preparation/mailing behavior must be recovered before a new stable baseline. A rewritten replacement is not acceptance-equivalent.
Application updates never replace data/ and must preserve rollback/integrity behavior.
Current meter reading/draft UI may be salvaged, but it cannot define the application baseline until all older protected modules pass regression.
